name: Argentina production
holds: Monthly oil, gas and water for every well in Argentina, with each well's location, operator history and operating state.
about: Argentina's Secretaría de Energía publishes what every well in the country produced each month. PetroDB reshapes those files into four tables that join on one key, idpozo, so a well's attributes are stored once instead of being repeated on 17.8 million monthly rows.

A well here means one wellbore producing from one formation: a wellbore that produces from two formations has two idpozo values. Column names are kept in Spanish exactly as the source publishes them; the schema document explains each one in English.

units.unit: hours on production in the month

queries.title: One well's production history
queries.why: The monthly table is split into one file per year. Read the file list first, then filter: each file is sorted by well, so DuckDB fetches only the parts that hold this well.
queries.python:
import json, urllib.request
import duckdb

base = "{base}/argentina/monthly_production/"
files = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(base + "_files.json"))
urls = [base + path for path in files]

well = duckdb.sql("""
    SELECT fecha, prod_pet, prod_gas, prod_agua
    FROM read_parquet($urls, hive_partitioning = true)
    WHERE idpozo = 160694   -- YPF.Nq.LLL-1577(h), a Vaca Muerta shale well
    ORDER BY fecha
""", params={"urls": urls}).df()
queries.polars:
import json, urllib.request
import polars as pl

base = "{base}/argentina/monthly_production/"
files = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(base + "_files.json"))

well = (
    pl.scan_parquet([base + path for path in files], hive_partitioning=True)
    .filter(pl.col("idpozo") == 160694)   # YPF.Nq.LLL-1577(h), a Vaca Muerta shale well
    .select("fecha", "prod_pet", "prod_gas", "prod_agua")
    .sort("fecha")
    .collect()
)

queries.title: Find wells by what you know about them
queries.why: Everything that describes a well lives in one 8 MB file. Start here to get the idpozo values you need, then use them to filter the monthly table.
queries.sql:
SELECT idpozo, sigla, empresa, yacimiento, profundidad
FROM '{base}/argentina/wells.parquet'
WHERE formprod = 'VMUT'               -- Vaca Muerta
  AND sub_tipo_recurso = 'SHALE'
  AND provincia = 'Neuquén'
ORDER BY profundidad DESC
LIMIT 20;
queries.polars:
import polars as pl

wells = (
    pl.scan_parquet("{base}/argentina/wells.parquet")
    .filter(
        (pl.col("formprod") == "VMUT")   # Vaca Muerta
        & (pl.col("sub_tipo_recurso") == "SHALE")
        & (pl.col("provincia") == "Neuquén")
    )
    .select("idpozo", "sigla", "empresa", "yacimiento", "profundidad")
    .sort("profundidad", descending=True)
    .head(20)
    .collect()
)

source.text: Data from Producción de petróleo y gas por pozo (Capítulo IV), published by the Secretaría de Energía on Argentina's open data portal. All three source files are resources of that one dataset package.
